text: this vertical stack looks really bad when you dont have any normalized size to the buttons. rethink that because i dont think you are thinking about it at all [Image #2] also the tooltips to nnot have the key on them which is usually the first thing you would show for a tooltip is the hotkey
resolution: Normalized the context-rail button sizing and put hotkeys in tooltips. First pass made the rail uniform-width (stretch); the user found full-width buttons had too much dead space for short labels. Final: rail is a wrapping Row (width 168) where text ops size to content and pack horizontally like a tool palette, with the move/resize/rotate trio kept as a full-width 3-across equal group (the part the user liked); dividers + the symmetrize header force line breaks. Tooltips that have a hotkey now lead with it (Ctrl+Z · Undo, Ctrl+Y · Redo, F · Reframe). Built green; self-shot confirms the trio sizing. Face-mode op packing needs a live screenshot to confirm.
